gen-luckiest-guy-gf-maven-pro: Luckiest Guy is loud, its ink poured thick and uniform. Maven Pro lets text roll on easily, with a welcoming gap in its c and line thickness that barely shifts.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-michroma: Michroma gives every letter a wide berth on both sides. Michroma does the wide-spaced reading work while Luckiest Guy does the cheerful shouting with lines of one constant thickness.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-miriam-libre: A mean, high-set line and ink that looks poured make Luckiest Guy loud. Miriam Libre draws thin as wire yet stands tall as cast iron capitals, and that tension is what makes the pair work.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Luckiest Guy shouts first, with a mean high line and poured ink. Mochiy Pop P One then spreads out with generous gaps between letters and a sizable lowercase, giving the loud heading plenty of room.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline reads breezily, its lowercase oversized beside its capitals. Its round bowls keep a uniform wall, so text beneath the loud Luckiest Guy heading glides along without snagging.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-nobile: Luckiest Guy hollers cheerfully in strokes of unvarying thickness. Nobile takes over below it, a sans whose capitals sit close to its lowercase and whose letter mouths stay open.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans: Loud, cheerful, poured-ink lettering: that is Luckiest Guy. Noto Sans, its lowercase filling most of the letter height, steps in as the plain sans doing the quiet reading work.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy gives its horizontals and verticals identical weight. And Noto Sans Arabic, tall in the lowercase with wide openings on small letters, makes the loud-meets-clean split the pair's hook.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Loud, with a cheerful streak, Luckiest Guy draws bars and stems at matching weight. Noto Sans Bengali then settles into text smoothly, its capitals barely taller than lowercase and its letter mouths distinctly open.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: A mean line set high and ink of constant width give Luckiest Guy its unmistakably loud, cheerful punch. Noto Sans Brahmi reads smoothly down the line, every curved letter left open-ended.
